findings: Choices allocate time and consumable equipment across connected goals; hand rescue preserves rope for another use.
The same cargo setup can save four people with either intact or spoiled medicine. Ferry rescue changes capacity and steering; forecasts match damage.
A full causeway outcome restores a permanent road; a full ferry outcome retains the river route. Neither result automatically replaces the other infrastructure.

Mara prioritizes concrete passengers/cargo; Iven supplies steering expertise; roof workers and the clinic appear in actual scenes. Repeated preparation exposition and a generic moral summary were removed during review.
Standalone conversation rules, trace and archived records remain preserved; adventure cooperation is a route unlock rather than an automatic crossing.

limitations: No independent playtest, accessibility/usability or market evidence; enjoyment and pacing are hypotheses.
Graph exploration starts at twelve representative river-entry configurations; it does not exhaust all workshop histories or prove literary quality.
Deterministic terminal prototype; no graphics, generated media, save/load or engine binding. No complete commercial product or license inferred.
